purpose: Two original prototype ground material textures for actual Eden Prime 3D meshes; not extracted original-game textures.

requests.prompt: ROLE/PURPOSE: A single seamless tileable albedo-style grass ground texture for a real 3D agricultural colony level in a French science-fiction fan RPG. SUBJECT: subdued cool grey-green cropped meadow grass with tiny low blades, very sparse fine brown earth speckles, small natural irregularities distributed evenly. VIEW: exact orthographic straight-down flat material scan, no perspective. ART DIRECTION: realistic physically plausible short turf with quiet medium-frequency microdetail, muted sage and olive-grey palette, average value medium, low broad-scale contrast so small character sprites remain readable above it. Lighting is perfectly flat diffuse and uniform, no directional lighting, no large highlights, no vignetting. TECHNICAL OUTPUT: exactly one square 1024 by 1024 opaque RGB/RGBA texture tile, edge-to-edge material coverage. Left and right edges must join seamlessly, top and bottom must join seamlessly, designed for repeating 3 by 3 on large ground meshes. DISTRIBUTION: homogeneous random field, avoid recognizable lumps, circular patches, flowers, weeds, stones, footprints, lines or any unique focal landmark. EXCLUDE: horizon, sky, buildings, scenery, logos, objects, text, frame, grid, checkerboard, transparent background, cast shadows, perspective, big grass tufts, painted borders, fake texture preview panels, normal-map colours, AO shadows. This is an original prototype material for the project, not a claim to reproduce or extract any original Mass Effect texture.

ROLE/PURPOSE: A single seamless tileable albedo-style compacted dirt ground texture for a real 3D agricultural colony footpath in a French science-fiction fan RPG. SUBJECT: subdued grey-ochre compact dry clay soil with fine granular earth and very sparse tiny desaturated pebbles, gently varied microscopic roughness distributed evenly, no large cracks or stones. VIEW: exact orthographic straight-down flat material scan, no perspective. ART DIRECTION: realistic compact agricultural track soil, muted neutral khaki-grey ochre palette, medium value and restrained broad-scale contrast so small character sprites remain readable. Lighting must be perfectly flat diffuse and uniform, without directional light, highlights, dark vignettes or cast shadows. TECHNICAL OUTPUT: exactly one square 1024 by 1024 opaque RGB/RGBA texture tile, edge-to-edge material coverage. Left and right edges join seamlessly, top and bottom edges join seamlessly, designed for seamless 3 by 3 repetition across long route meshes. DISTRIBUTION: homogeneous fine random granular field; no distinctive patches, wheel ruts, footprints, lines, crossroads or recognizable landmarks. EXCLUDE: horizon, sky, buildings, foliage, scenery, logs, props, text, border, grid, checkerboard, transparent background, perspective, big rocks, deep holes, baked shadows, material-ball previews, normal-map colours, AO shadows. This is an original prototype material for this project, not a reproduction or extraction of an original Mass Effect texture.
